marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF510B 20V ratchet features a 75 ft-lb torque rating, 20 V voltage rating, and 0 to 300 RPM speed rating. It includes an interchangeable anvil with 3/8 in and 1/4 in square drive options, a 20V MAX brushless motor, variable speed trigger, and LED work light. This compact design provides access in tight spaces.
